NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE VII: KNOWLEDGE, CONSENT AND SHARED WORK (LCG-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)

Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: The rains return after months of drought: celebrate first, or prepare for the next dry season first.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: After four months of dry weather, the rain has finally come. (friend) wants to dance in it and sing the rain song. (subject) knows that the rain also means it is time to dig catch-pools and repair the water channels, before the next dry season, and that the work goes best while the ground is soft. What should they do first?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: They dance in the rain with the whole village, then dig the catch-pools in the mud, singing. It takes longer, and it is the happiest work anyone has done all year.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) and (friend) dig the catch-pools first. By the time they finish, the rain is easing. They dance in the last of it, alone and muddy, and (friend) says it counts.
